craft_notes: Sthāyin: I-flower (ego as oblation). Rows: row 3 (I-blooms→praise). Close: praise (mother-word before it: Śāmbhavī mother). Rejected: 'ego' abstract — killed: I-making kept (ahaṅkṛti as act, the verse's psychology); 'Ambā' untranslated — killed: mother kept (ambā glossed, name intact in Śāmbhavī).

lines: She does Bhairava honor, on fire's petal, with I-blooms —

reads_against.argmap: Who offers I-ness? → Śāmbhavī (ahaṅkāra, Agni petal) worships with I-flowers; ego itself becomes the offering, not the obstacle.
c1_essence: Śāmbhavī mother offers I-flowers from fire's petal: ego itself the oblation.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
